mechanism: Sertraline inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing dronedarone concentrations and QT-prolongation risk; additive cardiac effects and serotonin syndrome potential.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval closely; consider alternative SSRI with less CYP450 inhibition (citalopram/escitalopram); adjust dronedarone dose if necessary and monitor for serotonergic symptoms.
